items.title: Sweet Corn Ear in Its Husk
items.alt: A complete golden corn ear has straight rows of kernels, green husks peeled downward and fine brown silk at its tip.
items.description: A complete golden corn ear has straight rows of kernels, green husks peeled downward and fine brown silk at its tip. Use this isolated illustration in a personal corn-themed design or classroom vocabulary activity.

items.title: Corn Cob Cross Section
items.alt: A short corn-cob section shows a pale central pith and surrounding golden kernels, with two loose kernels beside it.

items.title: Germinating Corn Kernel
items.alt: One golden maize kernel has a pale coleoptile with a green tip and several white roots emerging from its embryo end.

items.title: Young Corn Seedling
items.alt: A young maize seedling has arching narrow green leaves, a visible kernel beside the crown and fibrous roots in a small soil cutaway.
